system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, this is Ivan Rossi. I have an upcoming flight from Newark (EWR) on May 21, and I need to change it. My mother is really sick and I need to get home sooner, so I’d like to switch to a nonstop flight on the same day if possible.

Can you help me with this? Also, I’m willing to pay up to $100 for any change fees, but I really don’t want to buy a whole new ticket.

Yes, I’m here! Just to confirm, I’d like to first upgrade my ticket to regular economy if that’s needed to make changes. Can you please help me with that upgrade first? Once that’s done, I’d like to change my flight to a nonstop one on the same day.

Could you please confirm once my ticket is upgraded to economy before we move on to changing the flight? Thank you!

Hello? Just checking in—can you please let me know once my ticket has been upgraded to economy? I want to make sure that’s completed before we move on to changing my flight to a nonstop one. Thank you!

Are you still there? I just want to confirm that my ticket has been upgraded to economy before we proceed with changing my flight to a nonstop option on May 21. Please let me know once the upgrade is done. Thanks!

Sorry for the delay — I’m here and I can help. Before I can make any changes I need a couple things from you:

1) Please provide your user ID (exactly as on your profile).  
2) Please provide the reservation ID for the booking you want upgraded.  

A few quick clarifying questions so I do exactly what you want:
- Do you want the upgrade to regular economy for all passengers on the reservation, or only for yourself?  
- Confirm that you want me to only upgrade the cabin first and then, after I confirm that the upgrade completed, proceed to look for and switch you to a nonstop flight on May 21. (I will not attempt the flight change until you confirm the upgrade is done.)  
- You mentioned you’re willing to pay up to $100 for change fees — I will list the exact upgrade cost and any change fees once I pull up your reservation. I will only proceed with the upgrade if you reply “yes” to that detailed action.

Once you provide your user ID and reservation ID I will retrieve your reservation and return the exact upgrade cost, any fees, and the payment methods available from your profile so you can confirm.

Thank you for your help! Here’s the info you asked for:

1) My user ID is ivan_rossi_8555.
2) My reservation ID is [let’s say: EWR2105IR] (please let me know if you need the confirmation code from my email instead).

To answer your questions:

- I only need the upgrade to regular economy for myself.
- Yes, please only upgrade the cabin first. Once you confirm that’s done, then we can move on to changing my flight to a nonstop one on May 21.
- And yes, please let me know the exact upgrade cost and any fees before you proceed. I’ll confirm before you make any changes.

Thanks again!
Just following up—let me know if you need anything else from me to get started. I’m ready to confirm the upgrade once you send me the details and cost. Thanks!
Hi, just checking in! Please let me know the upgrade cost and any fees for switching my ticket to regular economy. I’ll confirm as soon as you send the details. Thanks!
